subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: Should this experimental Claws package-owner slice proceed as part of the open RFC stack once exact-head implementation and live behavior proof are complete?
rationale: The PR is maintainer-labeled, stacked on open drafts, adds new installer and persistent lifecycle behavior, and the available evidence does not establish final maintainer approval of the product direction.

options.title: Continue the RFC stack
options.body: Keep the PR open and complete exact-head review and live proof before landing it in stack order.

options.title: Pause the package slice
options.body: Hold this PR until the RFC or predecessor stack establishes a different ownership and installer contract.

recommendation.title: Continue the RFC stack
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open and complete exact-head review and live proof before landing it in stack order.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the only evidence-backed reviewer in the supplied context who reviewed the central package ownership and safety contracts.
